messages:
Anya: quick heads-up — i'm landing a small breaking change to the streaming iterator + retry defaults in the SDKs. need snippet updates across py/ts/go in docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :wave:
Matt: what's the breaking part exactly? rename or param changes?
Anya: rename + stable typed iterator. old pattern: `for chunk in stream()` now: `for event in stream.iter()` and we return `Event` objects instead of raw dicts. also default retry window tightened from 10s -> 5s (affects examples that show long sleeps).
Kim: ah — that will break a bunch of TS examples in the snippets folder. i can take TS if someone owns py/go.
Sam: i can take python. i'll update examples under docs/examples/python/streaming and run the tests.
Matt: i'll take Go. fyi the go snippet currently expects `map[string]any` for each chunk; switch to `types.Event` in examples.
Anya: thanks! minimal checklist: update code blocks, update migration note under docs/migration/sdk-streaming.md, and add a tiny test per SDK to ensure snippet compiles.
docs-bot: linked PR checklist added: docs, snippets, tests. See checklist in PR description.
Sam: python snippet draft (will paste soon):
Sam: ```python
from redwood import StreamingClient

client = StreamingClient()
for event in client.stream('gpt-3.5', prompt='...').iter():
    if event.type == 'token':
        print(event.text, end='')
    elif event.type == 'done':
        break
```
Sam: note: removed `chunk['delta']` style access. use attributes on Event.
Kim: TS draft:```ts
import { StreamingClient } from '@redwood/inference'

const client = new StreamingClient()
for await (const ev of client.stream('gpt-3.5', { prompt: '...' }).iter()) {
  if (ev.type === 'token') process.stdout.write(ev.text)
  if (ev.type === 'done') break
}
```
Kim: i'll also run `node tests/snippets/streaming.test.ts` after update.
Matt: Go draft:```go
client := inference.NewStreamingClient(nil)
it := client.Stream("gpt-3.5", inference.StreamOpts{Prompt: "..."}).Iter()
for it.Next() {
  ev := it.Event()
  switch ev.Type {
  case inference.EventToken:
    fmt.Print(ev.Text)
  case inference.EventDone:
    return
  }
}
```
Matt: i'll update the code sample files under docs/snippets/go/ and add a tiny `go test` that imports the snippet package.
Anya: also: pagination + retry examples — we tightened retry window so examples that show `time.sleep(12)` to demonstrate backoff need to be shortened. please remove artificial sleeps and prefer mocking in tests.
Sam: for python tests i'll add a small pytest that mocks the client and asserts we iterate events. e.g. use `monkeypatch` to yield two token events + done.
Kim: TS tests will use `nock` to stub streaming endpoint and assert event sequence.
Matt: Go: use httptest server stub.
Anya: tiny nit — update anchor links in the sidebar: docs/snippets/index.md references `streaming-legacy` file; change to `streaming-iter`. i'll include that in the PR description so reviewers see it.
devops-bot: deploy preview started for PR #1234 — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai/streams-migration
Sam: FYI i'm going to split the python snippet commit into two: 1) snippet change, 2) test + migration note. makes review easier.
Kim: same for TS. i'll tag `@anya` when ready for quick pass.
Matt: i'll drop a short migration blurb under the go sdk readme: example + upgrade snippet.
Anya: thanks all. target: land by EOD tomorrow. ping me if you need me to tweak SDK public-facing names (i tried to keep them ergonomic). :thumbsup:
Kim: sounds good. starting now.
Sam: starting python changes, will mark WIP on the PR.
Matt: starting go changes.
Anya: tiny follow-up — once snippets are updated, i'll push a small compat shim in the SDK that logs a deprecation message if someone calls the old `stream()` raw loop for one release. aim is to reduce breakage.
Sam: nice, that buys us time.
Anya: ok closing thread — will update PR description with exact file paths and checklist. thanks everyone :sparkles:
